author: Komorebi P.

design_disclosure.old_episode_analysis_status: relation spectroscopy and continuation outcomes on the published 930000/931000 episodes were inspected during design and are exploratory design context only
design_disclosure.fresh_episode_endpoint_status: no learned-checkpoint endpoint was computed on the exact serialized 940000/941000 episode realizations before freeze; prospectivity is only relative to those fresh coordinate realizations

scientific_question: On the frozen finite domains, do the systems show an entry-interface defect, finite observed-state cone safety, and path-dependent projective drift, and how do repeated-relator paths compare with the exact frozen control panel?

fresh_episode_domain.support_caveat: Fresh coordinate episodes remain inside the reconstructed D4 task support; this is not held-out-family generalization.

numeric_contract.recurrent_rule: normalize after every learned generator application
numeric_contract.minimum_facet_norm_semantics: pulled-back-facet conditioning abort threshold; any registered pulled-back decoder facet at or below this norm aborts the run
numeric_contract.hard_rule: argmax equals exact semantic target and target margin is strictly positive
numeric_contract.invalid_event_rule: fail closed on digest, shape, endpoint, permutation, count, zero/tiny norm, nonfinite value, or frozen-profile mismatch

entry_module.wrong_semantic_decoy: for declared q use incoming representative of q_dagger=(q+1) mod 8
entry_module.suffix_selection: all binary canonical words at every exact horizon

gates.E0: source, input, and numeric integrity pass
gates.E1: the known seed-0 state-2 anchor defect is confined to the empty suffix and seed-1 anchors remain correct
gates.E2: both uniform incoming-route reanchoring schemes repair all anchor errors without introducing a hard error through H=8
gates.E3: R-incoming and F-incoming representatives have identical hard continuation signatures through H=8
gates.E4: every decoy follows q_dagger under every suffix and never follows declared q

entry_module.scale_caveat: Native H=0 anchors retain stored scale; incoming states are normalized. H=0 soft differences therefore mix direction and stored scale.

cone_module.history_selection: all binary canonical words at every exact history depth and all eight starts
cone_module.suffix_selection: all binary canonical words cumulatively through H
cone_module.implementation: exact reached-state levels through history depth 8 plus one episode-local suffix-product and pulled-back-facet bank through H=8, with direct and recursive suffix audits
cone_module.primary_endpoint: strict finite K_q^(H) membership and minimum signed angular decoder-facet clearance at each exact (L,H)

gates.K0: every registered reached state is strictly correct under every suffix through H=8
gates.K1: recursive safe-cone and direct descendant enumeration agree exactly
gates.K2: every registered signed angular clearance exceeds 1e-10

cone_module.claim_limit: Observed-state finite membership does not establish nonempty ambient cones, full cone invariance, tower stabilization, or infinite-depth closure.

path_module.base_transversal: the 8 frozen nonempty D4 endpoint words in V031_FROZEN_INPUTS.json crossed with all 8 starts
primary_endpoints: absolute hard semantic or strict-margin failure
hard prediction disagreement from the same-semantic shallow baseline
first failure and first reveal suffix horizons

gates.B0: all 64 frozen base-transversal cases in every fresh episode are strictly eligible through H=8; H0-H3 are interpretable only when B0 is true
gates.P0: all grouped relation-block executions reproduce generator-wise rays within 1e-10
gates.H0: no eligible base case exits the finite hard cone anywhere on the registered repeat grid
gates.H1: at least one fresh-episode cone exit occurs by 64 inserted tokens
gates.H2: at least one common (relation, repeat_count) cell contains one or more exit events in all four checkpoint-seed by episode-index-half strata: seed 0 first, seed 0 second, seed 1 first, and seed 1 second; pooling exits across different cells does not satisfy H2
gates.H3: delayed exposure is present when at least one first hard reveal has suffix horizon greater than zero

path_module.claim_limit: The long-path module uses exactly one selected nonempty prehistory for each D4 endpoint crossed with eight starts: 64 base cases per episode. It does not enumerate all prehistories or recurrent states, and suffixes stop at H=8. Conclusions are restricted to this deterministic transversal and cannot be generalized to a path distribution. The cone module's exhaustive histories through L=8 do not make the long-path starting domain exhaustive.
path_module.spectral_caveat: frfr=(RF)^2 and rfrf=(FR)^2 have the same nonzero eigenvalue multiset by AB/BA structure; ordered-path attribution requires orbit, eigenvector, or cone evidence, not eigenvalues alone.

matched_control_module.reference_words: four repeated relation templates at inserted budgets 16, 32, and 64
matched_control_module.identity_pair_alias_structure: At each budget 16, 32, and 64, the frfr reference is the rfrf identity control and the rfrf reference is the frfr identity control. Thus six condition aliases reuse another condition's word and the two directed cells encode one unordered identity-path comparison per budget.
matched_control_module.optimality_scope: global over all binary words of the fixed length and requested D4 endpoint under the complete five-coordinate lexicographic ordering; the first three coordinates define scientific exposure matching, while Hamming distance and binary lexical order are deterministic tie-breaks
matched_control_module.exact_length_primary_panel: for each even-length reference, one globally optimal distinct control at each of the four parity-reachable D4 endpoints
matched_control_module.parity_obstruction: even word length reaches exactly e, R2, FR, and FR3; exact-length controls for R, R3, F, and FR2 do not exist
matched_control_module.parity_sandwich_secondary_panel: not materialized in v0.3.1; any later B-1/B+1 odd-endpoint panel must be separately frozen and may never be described as exact length matched
matched_control_module.comparison_rule: each path is scored against its exact semantic endpoint and a frozen shallow representative of that same endpoint
matched_control_module.endpoint_control_caveat: Only the distinct identity control holds the reference's semantic endpoint fixed. The R2, FR, and FR3 controls are exact-length and exposure-matched but cross semantic endpoints; their severity contrasts cannot by themselves separate path effects from endpoint or decoder-facet difficulty.
matched_control_module.severity_order: lexicographic descending in (hard-failing base-case count, hard-revealing base-case count, negative minimum target margin), aggregated separately within each checkpoint

gates.M0: all same-endpoint shallow baselines for e, R2, FR, and FR3 are strictly eligible through H=8; X0-X4 are interpretable only when M0 is true
gates.M1: the exact frozen bank executes 60 condition aliases corresponding to 54 distinct words in every episode

descriptive_classifications.X0: replicated nonidentity-control excess: in at least one relation-budget cell, the same one of R2, FR, or FR3 has strictly greater registered severity than the identity reference in each checkpoint aggregate
descriptive_classifications.X1: finite-pair identity-path hard-signature difference: in at least one relation-budget cell, the repeated identity relator and its one distinct exact-length identity control have a direct hard-signature disagreement in each checkpoint aggregate
descriptive_classifications.X2: finite-pair relator-reference severity dominance: in at least one relation-budget cell, the repeated identity relator has strictly greater registered severity than its one distinct exact-length identity control in each checkpoint aggregate
descriptive_classifications.X3: reference-over-all-nonidentity-control dominance: in at least one relation-budget cell, the repeated identity reference has strictly greater registered severity than each of the R2, FR, and FR3 controls in each checkpoint aggregate
descriptive_classifications.X4: mixed finite comparison pattern: X0 is true and at least one of X2 or X3 is true; the supporting cells need not be the same

matched_control_module.claim_limit: The matched-control module uses exactly one selected nonempty prehistory for each D4 endpoint crossed with eight starts: 64 base cases per episode. It does not enumerate all prehistories or recurrent states, and suffixes stop at H=8. Conclusions are restricted to this deterministic transversal and cannot be generalized to a path distribution. The cone module's exhaustive histories through L=8 do not make the matched-control starting domain exhaustive.
matched_control_module.inference_limit: The bank is a finite deterministic comparison set. No p-value, sampled-word population, general word-distribution claim, or promised separation of generic from relator-specific fragility is permitted.

gate_semantics: Integrity and eligibility gates are validity checks. H0-H3 and X0-X4 are outcome predicates, not success gates; H0 and H1 are logical complements, and no all-predicates-pass criterion exists.

composite_interpretation.entry_localized_finite: E0 and E1 and E2 and E3 and E4
composite_interpretation.registered_broadly_replicated_long_path_: B0 and P0 and H1 and H2
composite_interpretation.registered_delayed_reveal: B0 and P0 and H1 and H3
composite_interpretation.matched_classification_rule: Report X0-X4 only when M0 and M1 are true; otherwise report them as not interpretable, not false.
composite_interpretation.claim_limit: Every composite is descriptive on the frozen finite domains; none licenses infinite-depth, task-family, model-population, or universal-Neuralese claims.

execution_policy.one_shot_rule: the run-start ledger is atomically created after frozen-input validation and before checkpoint loading; any existing start, invalid-attempt, or result artifact permanently blocks another v0.3.1 execution
execution_policy.post_endpoint_code_changes: preserve original output; corrections require a separately disclosed v0.3.2 revision

claim_boundary: finite task-local behavior of two frozen eight-state systems only
no universal or architecture-independent language claim
no global invariant metric or normally attracting fiber claim
